name: prisoner-jump-squat
instructions:
1. Setup in a comfortable athletic position with the feet at roughly shoulder width apart, hands interlaced behind your head, and elbows high.
2. Descend quickly to a quarter squat position and then drive upwards as you extend your hips and knees.
3. Absorb the landing with your lower body by re-bending the knees and flexing the hips.
4. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
